about.heroSub: We're building the world's most expressive visual platform — a place where inspiration becomes identity.
about.missionTitle: Inspire the world, one aesthetic at a time
about.missionText1: Esthetic was founded on a simple belief — that visual inspiration should be personal, beautiful, and borderless. We built tools that let you capture your style, discover new ideas, and connect with people who see the world the way you do.
about.missionText2: From mood boards to auras, every feature is designed to help you express your aesthetic identity — not someone else's algorithm.

creativeFreedom.title: Creative Freedom
creativeFreedom.text: We believe everyone deserves a space to explore their aesthetic without limits. Esthetic is built around you — your taste, your vision, your world.

globalCommunity.title: Global Community
globalCommunity.text: Millions of creators, designers, and everyday dreamers use Esthetic to discover and share ideas across borders, cultures, and styles.

curatedQuality.title: Curated Quality
curatedQuality.text: Every pin, board, and aura on Esthetic is shaped by taste. Our smart recommendations surface content that matches your unique aesthetic profile.

privacyFirst.title: Privacy First
privacyFirst.text: Your data is yours. We give you full control over what's public, what's private, and how your creative identity is expressed online.

about.storyText1: Esthetic started as a student project with a bold idea: what if social media was designed around taste instead of trends? What if the feed felt like your own curated gallery?
about.storyText2: Today, that idea has grown into a global platform — but the core philosophy hasn't changed. Every decision we make starts with the creator.

business.hero: Grow your brand where taste lives
business.heroSub: Reach millions of design-conscious consumers through the most visually curated platform on the internet.

analytics.title: Analytics Dashboard
analytics.text: Track reach, engagement, and saves across your pins and boards. Understand what resonates with your audience and optimize your content strategy.

promotedPins.title: Promoted Pins
promotedPins.text: Put your brand in front of the right audience. Our smart targeting delivers your content to users whose aesthetic matches your brand identity.

creatorPartnerships.title: Creator Partnerships
creatorPartnerships.text: Connect with top creators on Esthetic whose style aligns with your brand. Build authentic collaborations that feel native to the platform.

brandCollections.title: Brand Collections
brandCollections.text: Curate branded mood boards and aura collections that showcase your products in context — the way your customers actually imagine using them.

globalReach.title: Global Reach
globalReach.text: Esthetic users span 120+ countries. Reach design-conscious consumers worldwide with localized campaigns and multi-language pin support.

brandSafety.title: Brand Safety
brandSafety.text: Your brand appears in a curated, high-quality environment. Our content moderation ensures your ads are never placed next to inappropriate content.

business.whyTitle: The audience you've been looking for
business.whyText1: Esthetic users are actively seeking inspiration — they're in a discovery mindset, open to new brands and products that match their aesthetic. That makes them the most receptive audience for visual marketing.
business.whyText2: Unlike other platforms, our users save and revisit content. Your promoted pin doesn't disappear in a feed — it becomes part of someone's mood board.

starter.name: Starter
starter.desc: Perfect for small brands and independent creators just starting out.

growth.name: Growth
growth.desc: For growing brands ready to scale their presence on Esthetic.

enterprise.name: Enterprise
enterprise.desc: Full-scale solutions for agencies and large brands.

business.ctaDesc: Join thousands of brands already reaching their audience through visual storytelling.

news.heroSub: Product updates, community stories, and behind-the-scenes from the team building your favourite visual platform.

featured_article.title: Introducing Aura 2.0 — Your Creative Identity, Reimagined
featured_article.excerpt: We've completely rebuilt the Aura experience from the ground up. New layouts, smarter recommendations, and a powerful new editor that puts your aesthetic front and center.

articles.title: Promoted Pins Now Available in 40 New Markets
articles.excerpt: Esthetic for Business is expanding. Brands in Europe, Asia-Pacific, and Latin America can now run promoted pin campaigns directly from the dashboard.

articles.title: Dark Mode Gets a Refresh — Deeper, Crisper, Better
articles.excerpt: We listened to your feedback. The new dark mode is more consistent, easier on the eyes, and beautifully paired with our updated color system.
